sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads the number of people N and prints the maximum number of handshakes.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: N = 1 to 5 use hardcoded sums, and larger values use N * (N - 1) / 2 converted to int. The N = 2 branch prints 2.
